limitations: Generated PCM was supplied through Chromium fake getUserMedia into the production AudioWorklet, Worker, detector and Wait path. No physical piano, microphone, room acoustics or physical latency was evaluated.
All QA app output was muted and windows offscreen/unfocusable, with isolated data and Electron storage. Permission denial, disconnected track and MIDI were simulated.
The AudioServiceSandbox Chromium feature was disabled only in isolated QA to permit the fake capture WAV file. Production sandbox and permission configuration were not changed.
Coaching integration used one delayed stubbed NDJSON text response. This proves asynchronous gating and metadata shape, not model quality.

Native range/chord coverage does not establish universal acoustic recognition. Current detector supports C3-C6 and up to three simple distinct notes; ambiguous octave/fifth combinations, dense pedalling, noisy rooms and very soft notes remain limited.
Extra octave notes can blend with natural overtones and falsely match. Physical-piano accuracy is unverified.
180–252 ms recorded-note fixture confirmation excludes physical microphone, queue and display latency.
Some cold launches and native inspection attempts timed out; subsequent attempts worked. The underlying startup delay is not claimed fixed.
